runs.text: This heat wave program gets the lesson's case right. Find 14 temperatures it gets wrong.

hints.text: Go back to the card in the lesson. Which edge case does the task's example not test?
Compare both programs. Which part of the lesson is this one missing?
Look for a wave that has not broken yet when the data runs out.
With the last three days above 30, the good one says one wave of 3 and this one says 0. Close with the variant.

runs.text: What does this program show if all 14 days are above 30? (Waves: 0. The good one says a wave of 14.)
The program is missing the closing of the last streak after the loop. Any series whose last streak of 3 or more days reaches the end breaks it.
